typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Aging as string,
		CCY as string,
		Side as string,
		Investigator as string,
		Dept as string,
		DF1073 as string,
		NextActionDate as string,
		CaseID as string,
		Account_Name as string,
		CCY_Amount as string,
		USD_Equiv_Amt as string,
		Value_Date as string,
		DorC as string,
		Case_Type as string,
		Case_Sub_Type as string,
		Case_Status as string,
		UpdateDateTime as string,
		UserUpdateDateTime as string,
		TranRef as string,
		IncomingTRN as string,
		CMR_ID as string,
		Customer_Legal_Name as string,
		Covering_Employee_Name as string,
		Create_Date as string,
		Create_Time as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> PegaCases
PegaCases split(ltrim(toString(rtrim(toString(CaseID),' ')),' ') == '', disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(Case1,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit@ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput derive(USD_Equiv_Amt = replace(iifNull(USD_Equiv_Amt,'0'), toString(' '), toString('0')),
		Investigator = iif(ltrim(toString(rtrim(toString(Investigator),' ')),' ') == '', 'Blank', Investigator)) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Case_Status as string,
		Customer_Legal_Name as string,
		Dept as string,
		CCY_Amount as string,
		DF1073 as string,
		Create_date as string,
		Value_date as string,
		D_C as string,
		Incoming_TRN as string,
		Investigator as string,
		User_Update_Date_Time as string,
		Side as string,
		Next_Action_Date as string,
		Update_Date_Time as string,
		Tran_Ref as string,
		Aging as string,
		Covering_Employee_Name as string,
		Case_ID as string,
		Case_Sub_Type as string,
		USD_Equiv_Amt as string,
		CMR_ID as string,
		Account_name as string,
		Create_time as string,
		CCY as string,
		Case_type as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Case_Status,
		Customer_Legal_Name,
		Dept,
		CCY_Amount,
		DF1073,
		Create_date = Create_Date,
		Value_date = Value_Date,
		D_C = DorC,
		Incoming_TRN = IncomingTRN,
		Investigator,
		User_Update_Date_Time = UserUpdateDateTime,
		Side,
		Next_Action_Date = NextActionDate,
		Update_Date_Time = UpdateDateTime,
		Tran_Ref = TranRef,
		Aging,
		Covering_Employee_Name,
		Case_ID = CaseID,
		Case_Sub_Type,
		USD_Equiv_Amt,
		CMR_ID,
		Account_name = Account_Name,
		Create_time = Create_Time,
		CCY,
		Case_type = Case_Type),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
